ModMetaData.name: Everything Has Quality Reforked
ModMetaData.author: KyleMHB
ModMetaData.description: Expands item quality with inherited category rules and individual exceptions. Optional quality effects start disabled and can be enabled through previewable presets or separate controls. Save options and restart RimWorld to activate changes. Includes selected durability, production, equipment, combat, power, battery, food, medicine, ordinary-drug and native linked-furniture effects. Storage capacity and installed-bionic effects are omitted. Back up saves before removing mod-added quality support or uninstalling. Requires Harmony.
